approval_basis: The project owner explicitly approved all four source entries for the uses recorded below.

sources.name: NeurIPS 2024 Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset
sources.redistribution: No source or derived spectra will be redistributed without a separate terms review
sources.notes: Approved for pretraining and evaluation in this project. If data are published, comply with the CDLA-Sharing-1.0 publication requirements. Preserve release identifiers and hashes in every dataset manifest.

sources.name: Spectroscopy Data for Undergraduate Teaching
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for Figshare supporting file 42316857; article text is CC BY 4.0
sources.redistribution: Attribution and noncommercial restrictions apply; redistribution is outside the current project scope
sources.notes: Approved for experimental evaluation, exact-molecule exclusion, and scaffold-exclusion analysis.

sources.name: nmrshiftdb2
sources.license: Extended ODC Open Database License terms accepted by the project owner for evaluation
sources.redistribution: No database dump or derived database will be redistributed by this project
sources.notes: Evaluation is limited to measured spectra with usable structures and metadata; keep the database-data license distinct from the software license.

sources.name: MassBank open data
sources.license: License is carried by individual MassBank records
sources.redistribution: Record-level license filter and attribution remain mandatory
sources.notes: Approved for evaluation only after retaining records whose LICENSE field permits the intended use; the project-level approval does not override a record license.
